coachEvents.text: Jab, cross, lead hook, cross — straight time, twelve bars. Jab, cross, lead hook, cross. Stay heavy without getting slow.
Cross, lead hook, cross — time-and-a-half, eighteen bars. Cross, lead hook, cross. Sit down, then get back under yourself.
Jab, cross, lead hook — double-time, twenty-six bars. Three fast power shots, one empty slot. Do not chase the bag.
Jab, jab, cross — straight time, seven bars. Double jab, cross. Finish the round behind the straight shot.
